# An invoice block with its lines cut off.
#
# The three fields above the lines are the ones read unconditionally, so a
# block truncated after them still parses — a file cut short by a failed
# write, a copy-paste that stopped early, a hand edit interrupted.
#
# The document is rebuilt from its block, which is the model: the file is the
# source of truth for the lines. But nothing told "the writer restated one
# line" apart from "the writer's file stops here", so a truncated block
# unposted the invoice — destroying the posting and orphaning its payments —
# and left it with no lines at all.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the invoice, with the document
# left as it was.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_document_block_with_no_lines.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

invoice "INV-CUT"
	customer_id: "C-CUT"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
